**Description**
```caclmgrd``` crashed during ```fast-reboot``` with following log
```
Nov 11 <IPV6>.363924 str-dx010-acs-4 INFO caclmgrd[1169]: terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Nov 11 <IPV6>.364120 str-dx010-acs-4 INFO caclmgrd[1169]:   what():  Unable to read redis reply

Nov 11 <IPV6>.816691 str-dx010-acs-4 WARNING systemd[1]: caclmgrd.service: Failed with result 'core-dump'.
```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Just run ```fast-reboot```, and the issue will repro

3.

resolution.title: Handle exception in Select
resolution.description:
Fixed https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5893

Original, `caclmgrd` crashed during ```fast-reboot``` with following log. Note that the exception handling already improves, so different from the log in the above issue
```
Dec  4 <IPV6>.964034 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]: Traceback (most recent call last):
Dec  4 <IPV6>.964250 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 670, in <module>
Dec  4 <IPV6>.964377 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:     main()
Dec  4 <IPV6>.964509 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 666, in main
Dec  4 <IPV6>.964631 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:     caclmgr.run()
Dec  4 <IPV6>.964751 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:   File "/usr/local/bin/caclmgrd", line 610, in run
Dec  4 <IPV6>.964891 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:     (state, selectableObj) = sel.select(SELECT_TIMEOUT_MS)
Dec  4 <IPV6>.965014 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:   File "/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/swsscommon/swsscommon.py", line 1322, in select
Dec  4 <IPV6>.965135 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]:     return _swsscommon.Select_select(self, timeout)
Dec  4 <IPV6>.965262 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2660]: RuntimeError: Unable to read redis reply
Dec  4 <IPV6>.013540 sonic NOTICE systemd[1]: caclmgrd.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Dec  4 <IPV6>.013784 sonic WARNING systemd[1]: caclmgrd.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
```

After this PR, `caclmgrd` will report errors during ```fast-reboot```
```
Dec  4 <IPV6>.682565 sonic ERR caclmgrd[2165]: :- poll_descriptors: readData error: Unable to read redis reply
Dec  4 <IPV6>.781333 sonic ERR caclmgrd[2165]: :- poll_descriptors: readData error: Unable to read redis reply
Dec  4 <IPV6>.870789 sonic INFO caclmgrd[2165]: DaemonBase: Caught SIGTERM - exiting...
Dec  4 <IPV6>.911119 sonic NOTICE systemd[1]: caclmgrd.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=143/n/a
Dec  4 <IPV6>.911374 sonic WARNING systemd[1]: caclmgrd.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
```
